full_page.content:
1949, May 30
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
St. Felix Friary Route 8 Huntington, Indiana 5 / 30 / 49
Bles'd be God in all things
My Dear Brother Edw'd:
God bless you and yours. Pardon my tardiness in complying with demands of -- correspondence.
Thanks be to God I've had some really practical exercises recently that befit a capuchin novitiate ..... Four weeks ago we drove over to Milwaukee for a celebration in honor of Fr. Stephen Eckert, whose Dominicad (Dominican brother) Br. Michael you must have ..... From Notre Dame. ... Afterwards they ambulanced me to St. Michael's Hospital - thence after two days to St. Felix - St. Joseph Hospital Ft. Wayne for two long weeks (16 days) and now again back to the Novitiate .... Deo Gratias.
They seem to think they had pretty critical patient I can genuflect again .... and can eat - "no foolin."
Now to catch up a little with letters, etc .... God help us ...
I surely sympathize with you and your practical associate .. . . Best wishes to all ... .including down to the personnel of St. Joseph Hospital where I met such really fraternal and sister- like encouragement! .... I always bring away with me newly awakened memories from St. Thomas.
Praised be Jesus Christ!
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
God bless Fr. Cashman ... and all the great work:
